question: Should OpenClaw add a durable `allowAlwaysKey` plugin approval API now, and what stable non-sensitive owner/scope must built-in Skill Workshop use before merge?
rationale: The PR changes plugin-facing API and durable approval reuse for future sensitive actions; automation can identify the unsafe scope but cannot choose the permanent trust boundary or product contract.

options.title: Fix durable scope before merge
options.body: Keep the generic backend only after adding a stable owner, replacing request-visible workspace paths, rebasing over current main, and proving second-call Skill Workshop reuse.

options.title: Split Skill Workshop opt-in
options.body: Review the generic plugin API separately and keep built-in Skill Workshop lifecycle approvals on `allow-once`/`deny` until its owner/audit model is ready.

options.title: Pause durable API direction
options.body: Close or hold this branch and track the broader approval API/security model in the open approval API and Skill Workshop approval issues.

recommendation.title: Fix durable scope before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the generic backend only after adding a stable owner, replacing request-visible workspace paths, rebasing over current main, and proving second-call Skill Workshop reuse.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily about the plugin approval framework contract that joshavant introduced and this branch extends.
